c-stale.value: Meters older than 20 minutes (`HARNESS_QUOTA_STALE_MS`) are dimmed in the bar, and the tooltip and popover say "stale · updated N ago", as Settings and CodexBar do.

c-customize.value: No per-harness pin or hide in this change; the automatic priority ranking above decides. Disabling a harness still hides it, as today.

c-disabled-members.value: A disabled account in no stack stays hidden (#201). A disabled **stack member** shows as a muted "disabled" dot on the stack chip and in the popover, so the stack's makeup stays honest.

c-one-member.value: A stack with fewer than 2 enabled members renders as a plain account chip: no stack marker and no "fails over" copy, per the harness-stacks rule "One-account stacks".

c-tooltips.value: Icon buttons switch from native `title` to the portaled `ui/tooltip.tsx`, as the RunPanel header did. Accessible names (`Git`, `Worktrees`, `Settings`, `Import Claude Code sessions…`) and `data-testid`s stay unchanged, and the e2e `headerSettingsButton` helper moves to the accessible name.

c-a11y.value: Chips and actions stay plain buttons in tab order. The overflow and More controls are menu buttons (`aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded`, arrow keys, Escape returns focus). Hidden copies are `inert`. Status is never conveyed by color alone (tooltip or aria-label text). Every popover carries `data-popover-open`, closes on Escape and is portaled.

c-drag.value: Empty space in the bar, including the space around the chips, still drags the window, and double-clicking it still zooms. Only the controls themselves are `no-drag`.

c-scope.value: macOS only (traffic-light inset). No new npm dependency: the fit logic is hand-rolled (`ResizeObserver` plus `ui/context-menu.tsx`). No change to the CLI or TUI; `agetor harness ls` already shows stack and quota state.

c-tests.value: Unit tests for the pure fit, priority and stack-summary logic. Component tests with `renderToStaticMarkup`. A new e2e spec with 7 harnesses and a 2-member stack at 1440, 1100, 900 and your minimum width, at 100% and 170% zoom, and with RunPanel open: `scrollWidth == clientWidth`, the always-visible actions are clickable, overflow and More open and close with Escape, and the stack popover shows its members and cooldowns. All existing e2e specs stay green.

c-docs.value: A new `docs/architecture/app-bar.md` (layout, overflow policy, drag regions, zoom, RunPanel) added to CLAUDE.md's topic map; the app bar added to `harness-stacks.md` § Surfaces → Webview; `README.md` usage-meter line updated; the Grill-28 reversal recorded in the plan.
